qa_pairs.instruction: What is the Delimited Text driver and what does it do?
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver lets you use delimited text files (CSV) to synchronize data between the Identity Vault and applications. Essentially, it allows you to transfer data from the Identity Vault to any system that can consume delimited text files, or transfer data to the Identity Vault from any system that can generate delimited text files.

qa_pairs.instruction: Can the Delimited Text driver work with file formats other than CSV?
qa_pairs.output: Yes, the Delimited Text driver can also be modified to consume XML files in addition to delimited text files (CSV).

qa_pairs.instruction: In which directions can the Delimited Text driver synchronize data?
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver can synchronize data bidirectionally: it can transfer data from the Identity Vault to any system that can consume delimited text files, and it can also transfer data to the Identity Vault from any system that can generate delimited text files.
